1047.description: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

1111.description: A narrow-hand push on the straps that shifts work toward the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

1175.description: A lunge with a forward torso lean that shifts more of the load onto the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

1303.description: From a three point stance with one hand on a medicine ball, you push the ball away explosively. It trains the chest and arms with power and balance.
instructions: Start in a 3 point stance with one hand on the medicine ball and the other hand on the ground.
Extend your legs and position your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Push the medicine ball away from your body, extending your arm fully.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 以三点姿势开始，一只手放在健身球上，另一只手放在地上。
伸展双腿并将身体摆成一条直线。
将胸部压向地面，同时保持背部挺直。
将药球推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
返回起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。

1367.description: A pull-up on a wide overhand grip, pulling to the back of your neck or upper chest. It targets the lats and upper back.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 正手宽握抓住引体向上杆，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1431.description: A chin-up done on an assisted machine that takes part of your body weight. It builds the lats and biceps while you work up to full chin-ups.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired assistance level.
Stand on the foot platform and grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back, engage your core, and slightly bend your knees.
Pull your body up by flexing your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整至您所需的辅助级别。
站在脚踏板上，正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持挺胸、肩膀向后，收紧核心肌群，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
弯曲肘部并将肘部向身体两侧压低，将身体向上拉。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1495.description: An oblique crunch where you curl up and to the side, version 2. It trains the side abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the ground, rotating your torso to one side.
Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回起始位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1559.description: You kneel with a stability ball for support and push the hips forward. It stretches the hip flexors at the front of the hip.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and kneel in front of it.
Place your right foot on top of the stability ball, with your knee bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Lean forward, pushing your hips towards the stability ball, until you feel a stretch in your right hip flexor.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地上并跪在其前面。
将右脚放在稳定球上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将左腿伸到身后，保持伸直。
身体前倾，将臀部推向稳定球，直到感觉到右髋屈肌有拉伸感。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

1623.description: An incline bench press with palms facing in. It trains the triceps and the front delts with a shoulder-friendly grip.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the backrest and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells slowly towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地上。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝内。
将手臂伸直至胸部上方，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
将哑铃慢慢向肩膀方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将哑铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1687.description: A step back with an overhead reach. It warms up the hips and core and stretches the front of the body.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Take a step back with your right foot, landing on the ball of your foot.
Bend your left knee and lower your body into a lunge position.
As you lower into the lunge, simultaneously reach your arms overhead.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the lunge, then return to the starting position by pushing through your left heel and bringing your right foot forward.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping back with your left foot and bending your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，双臂放在身体两侧。
右脚向后退一步，用脚掌着地。
弯曲左膝并将身体降低至弓步位置。
当你降低弓步时，同时将手臂举过头顶。
在弓步底部暂停片刻，然后通过推动左脚跟并将右脚向前拉回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向后退一步并弯曲右膝盖。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1751.description: A barbell press from pins set in a rack, starting from a dead stop. Builds pressing strength through the triceps and chest.
instructions: Set up a barbell on a power rack at chest height.
Stand facing the barbell and position yourself underneath it, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest, with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃放在与胸部同高的力量架上。
面向杠铃站立，将自己置于杠铃下方，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其保持在胸部正上方，双臂完全伸展。
将杠铃向胸部方向降低，保持肘部靠近身体。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1815.description: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight and palm down.
Use your other hand to rotate the palm outward until you feel a stretch along your forearm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1879.description: Rest one leg on a raised surface and lean in to stretch the hips.
instructions: Stand facing a bench or step.
Place one heel on it with the knee slightly bent.
Keep your chest tall and hinge forward at the hips.
Feel the stretch in the hip and glute.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1943.description: A yoga-style hip opener with one shin folded in front, stretching the glutes and the hip flexors of the back leg.
instructions: Start on hands and knees and slide one knee forward behind your wrist.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Lower your hips toward the floor and keep your chest tall.
Fold forward over the front leg for a deeper stretch if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2071.description: A one-leg hip thrust that works the glutes hard and challenges balance and hip stability.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and one foot flat on the floor.
Extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the heel to lift your hips until your body is flat.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

2135.description: A forearm plank held with extra weight on your back. Builds core strength and stability.
instructions: Start by lying face down on the floor.
Place your forearms on the ground, with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, with your toes on the ground.
Engage your core and lift your body off the ground, balancing on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先脸朝下躺在地板上。
将前臂放在地面上，肘部直接位于肩膀下方。
将双腿伸直在身后，脚趾着地。
启动你的核心并将你的身体抬离地面，用前臂和脚趾保持平衡。
保持身体从头部到脚跟呈一条直线。
保持此位置所需的时间。
将身体放低至起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2327.description: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down, fully extended, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
双手各握一个哑铃，正手握握，手掌朝向身体。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
让你的手臂伸直垂下，完全伸展，肘部稍微弯曲。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2711.description: A low squat-walk holding a load, building leg endurance and hip strength.
instructions: Hold the weight in front of you and lower into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up.
Take small steps while staying low.
Keep your core braced and your knees tracking over your toes.
Walk the full distance, then stand and rest.

2775.description: Raising the arm out to the side, working the side of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2839.description: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

2903.description: A rear lunge using a power sled for resistance. Builds glute and thigh strength.
instructions: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

3095.description: A sideways leap from one leg to the other. It builds lateral power and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Push off hard to leap sideways.
Land on the opposite foot and bend to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second to stay balanced.
Bound back the other way.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your toes.

3223.description: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump up explosively.
As you jump, spread your legs and extend your arms out to the sides, forming a star shape with your body.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂放在身体两侧。
稍微弯曲膝盖并爆发性地跳起来。
跳跃时，张开双腿，将手臂向两侧伸展，与身体形成星形。
膝盖轻轻弯曲，脚掌轻轻着地。
重复所需的重复次数。

3287.description: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双手抓住臀部旁边的边缘。
将臀部向前滑离长凳，伸直双腿，保持脚后跟着地。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3351.description: A lunge with cable resistance, building leg strength with a constant load.
instructions: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

3415.description: A supported nordic-style curl where assistance lets you control the lowering for the hamstrings.
instructions: Kneel with your ankles secured and your torso upright.
Use the assistance as needed.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and hands if needed.
Keep your hips extended.

3479.description: A squat that adds a side kick and a heel touch for legs and coordination.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Squat down.
Stand and kick one leg to the side.
Touch the heel with your hand.
Squat again.
Alternate sides.

3543.description: A squat that ends with an explosive jump, bringing the feet together in the air. It builds leg power and cardio.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately drop back into a squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性地跳起来，伸展臀部、膝盖和脚踝。
在半空中时，快速将双脚并拢。
脚掌轻轻着地，然后立即回到蹲姿。
重复所需的重复次数。

3671.description: A side-to-side hopping drill that imitates a skier. It raises the heart rate and builds leg stamina.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
稍微弯曲膝盖并保持背部挺直。
跳到右侧，右脚着地，同时将左腿摆动到右腿后面。
立即向左侧跳，左脚着地，同时将右腿摆动到左腿后面。
继续从一侧到另一侧交替跳跃，模仿滑雪动作。
重复所需的重复次数。

3735.description: A lying pullover with a kettlebell that stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell with both hands above your chest.
Keep your arms slightly bent.
Lower the bell back over your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.

3799.description: A bent-over row with an underhand grip. It works your upper back, lats and biceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

3863.description: A single-leg squat jump with the rear foot elevated, building explosive power and balance in each leg.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

3927.description: A squat performed on your tiptoes that challenges balance, the quads and the calves.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rise onto your toes.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down while staying up on your toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
Keep your chest tall.

3991.description: A wide grip bent over row done with alternating pulls. It builds the upper back and lats.
instructions: Hinge forward holding the barbell with a wide grip.
Keep your back flat.
Pull one side toward your ribs.
Lower and pull the other side.
Keep your hips still.

4055.description: Seated side raise performed on a stability ball. It trains the side delts and trunk balance.
instructions: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

4119.description: A triceps extension done on a sled machine, giving steady load through the whole motion.
instructions: Set up on the sled and grip the handles or bar.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Extend your arms to straighten them.
Squeeze your triceps at the end.
Return slowly.

4183.description: A seated move combining an upright row, rotation and press. It strengthens shoulders and rotator cuff.
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your thighs.
Row them up to chest height with elbows high.
Rotate your forearms upward.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Reverse the path slowly.
Use light weights.

4247.description: A Romanian deadlift using the landmine bar for an angled load. It builds the hamstrings and glutes with a good hip hinge.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar with both hands in front of your thighs.
Stand with soft knees and a flat back.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your legs.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

4375.description: Circle a medicine ball around your head to warm up the shoulders and challenge your core and balance.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core and keep your hips still.
Pass the ball around your head in a smooth circle, keeping it close.
Complete several circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back as the ball passes behind you.

4439.description: An explosive lift pulling dumbbells from the floor to the shoulders and then overhead.
instructions: Stand over dumbbells with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip them with a flat back.
Pull explosively, extend your hips and shrug.
Catch the dumbbells at your shoulders, then dip and drive them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then the floor with control.

4567.description: A one-arm rope kickback that works the triceps with steady cable tension.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end with a neutral grip.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and tucked in.
Straighten your elbow and pull the rope back.
Squeeze at the end of the motion.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

4631.description: A face-down rotational stretch that opens the hips, chest and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and swing that foot up and across your body.
Reach toward the opposite hand and keep shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

4695.description: A one-arm upright row with a band. It works the shoulders and traps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the other end in one hand at your thigh.
Keep your elbow leading the movement.
Pull your hand up toward your chest, elbow higher than the wrist.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch arms.

4887.description: A glute bridge with dumbbells resting on your hips, a second variation. The added weight makes the glutes work harder.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on each hip and hold them in place.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your hips slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

4951.description: A squat on a pendulum machine that swings along an arc. It loads the quads heavily.
instructions: Load the machine and step onto the platform.
Place your shoulders under the pads.
Unlock the machine and lower in a controlled squat.
Go as deep as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up and heels down.

5079.description: Lie on the floor and sweep dumbbells out and together in an arc. The floor limits the range, which is gentle on the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out until your upper arms touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back together.
Keep your wrists straight and the motion slow.

5143.description: Drag a loaded sled behind you by walking backward or forward. It builds leg drive and conditioning.
instructions: Load a sled and attach a harness or straps.
Lean slightly forward and brace your core.
Walk with powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your back straight.
Cover a set distance, then rest and repeat.

5335.description: A kettlebell complex that links a swing, clean, front squat and press. A full-body strength and conditioning flow.
instructions: Stand over the kettlebell and swing it back between your legs.
Swing it up, then clean it to the rack position at your shoulder.
Squat down with the bell held in front of you.
Stand up and press the bell overhead.
Lower it back with control for the next rep.
Switch arms after your set.

5399.description: Holding a stick overhead or in front while you brace your midsection. Builds trunk stability and teaches you to keep the ribs down.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a stick in both hands.
Raise the stick to the position you are cued for and keep your arms steady.
Brace your abs as if preparing for a light punch and tuck the ribs down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the stick slowly and shake out your arms.

5527.description: Machine rear-delt fly where you lean forward and sweep your arms back.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your chest on the pad and grip the handles.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Open your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause, then return slowly.
Do not shrug.

5911.description: A hip hinge with a safety squat bar resting on your shoulders, strengthening the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Set the safety bar on your upper back and shoulders and hold the handles.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is near parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and neck neutral.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

5975.description: Cross punches thrown while balancing on one leg, which trains balance, rotation and core control.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and fists up.
Brace your core.
Throw a cross punch, rotating your hips and shoulders.
Pull your fist back to guard.
Keep your standing foot steady.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

6103.description: A Pilates move where you lift your legs and trunk together to fold at the hips. It challenges the abs and balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Lift both legs up toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor and lift your hips slightly.
Raise your trunk and reach toward your toes.
Roll back down slowly with control.
Keep your movement smooth, without swinging.

6231.description: A knee push-up followed by a pullback of the hips. It trains the chest and adds a mobility element.
instructions: Start in a knee push-up position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press back up.
Push your hips back toward your heels.
Return to the start.
Keep your core tight.

6295.description: A seated forward fold with a twist and a bent knee. It stretches the back, hips and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

6359.description: A standing wrist curl with dumbbells that builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6423.description: From a plank, you bend and straighten your elbows to hinge forward and press back, a tough bodyweight move for the triceps.
instructions: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

6551.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach that works your legs and stretches your torso.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

7255.description: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.

7895.description: A kneeling thoracic mobility move combining a rear fly and a thread-the-needle reach.
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8343.description: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Press your arms up and slightly back while lifting your chest.
Extend through your upper back without flaring your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Repeat for smooth, slow reps.

8663.description: A cable Y raise using wrist straps to reduce grip demand, supported on an incline bench.
instructions: Fasten the wrist straps to the cables and lie chest-down on an incline bench.
Keep your neck neutral.
Raise your arms forward and up into a Y shape.
Squeeze your shoulders at the top.
Lower slowly.

9047.description: With your heels on a ball and hips lifted, you curl it in with one leg. It hits the hamstrings and glutes hard.
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Keep your hips high.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

10199.description: A Romanian deadlift where the dumbbells reach across the body, training the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

10327.description: A seated Russian twist with a kettlebell, taking the weight side to side to work the obliques and abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.

10903.description: A one-arm pull-up where a band takes some of your body weight. It helps you work toward an unassisted rep.
instructions: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

11095.description: A gentle spinal stretch you can do on a chair. It moves your back through flexion and extension to ease stiffness.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your hands on your knees and feet flat.
Inhale, arch your back and lift your chest.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 8-10 breaths.

11287.description: A Romanian deadlift holding a kettlebell behind you. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and reinforces a straight back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

11799.description: A bent-over sweeping raise with light dumbbells that targets the rear and side delts through a long arc.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

0023.description: A standing curl where the arms lift the bar alternately, keeping tension on the biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and exhale as you curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale as you slowly begin to lower the barbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手握住一个杠铃，手掌朝前。
保持上臂静止，在弯举哑铃时呼气，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。

0087.description: A seated press in which the bar moves between the front of the shoulders and just above the head, never fully locking out.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly bent and pointing forward.
Press the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，杠铃间距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微弯曲并指向前方。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0151.description: A cable press from a bench. Trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to chest height and attach the handles.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and step forward to create tension in the cables.
Position your feet firmly on the ground and engage your core.
Bend your elbows and bring your hands to shoulder level, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward, extending your arms fully in front of you.
Pause for a moment, then slowly reverse the movement, bringing your hands back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索机调整至胸部高度并安装手柄。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并向前迈一步，以在电缆中产生张力。
将双脚牢牢放在地面上并启动核心。
弯曲肘部，将双手置于肩部水平，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
向前推动手柄，将双臂完全伸展到身前。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢扭转动作，将双手放回肩部水平。
重复所需的重复次数。

0215.description: A seated cable rear raise: arms sweep out to the sides to the level of the shoulders. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至前方。
保持手臂伸直，慢慢向两侧举起，直到与地板平行。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0279.description: A push-up with the feet raised on a surface. The incline puts more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your hands on the ground slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with your feet elevated on a stable surface.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core muscles.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在地面上，距离略宽于肩宽，双脚放在稳定的表面上。
保持身体从头到脚呈一条直线，锻炼核心肌肉。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0343.description: A one-arm dumbbell press on a flat bench. Working one side at a time shows up any imbalance.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the dumbbell at shoulder level with your palm facing forward.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，双脚平放在地上。
将哑铃举至肩部水平，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0407.description: Standing with a dumbbell in one hand, you bend sideways and return. It works the side abs, the obliques.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, letting it hang down by your side.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend sideways at the waist towards the opposite side of the dumbbell, lowering the weight as far as you comfortably can.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，一手握住哑铃，让它垂在身侧。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与，慢慢地将腰部向哑铃的另一侧侧弯，在舒适的范围内尽可能降低重量。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边重复。

0471.description: You press your body upward while inverted against a wall. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Find a wall and face away from it, standing a few feet away.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart and kick your feet up against the wall, coming into a handstand position.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the ground, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 找到一堵墙，背对墙，站在几英尺远的地方。
将双手放在地面上，与肩同宽，然后将脚踢到墙上，形成倒立姿势。
弯曲肘部，将头低向地面，保持身体呈一条直线。
用手推动并伸展双臂以返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0535.description: You swing a kettlebell from a hang position up to the rack at your shoulder in one smooth pull. Trains the hips, back and shoulders for power.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower the kettlebell towards the ground, allowing it to swing between your legs.
Quickly extend your hips and knees, using the momentum to swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your wrists and catch the kettlebell in the rack position, with your elbow tucked in and the kettlebell resting on your forearm.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position between your legs, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将壶铃放在大腿前面。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将壶铃放低至地面，使其在双腿之间摆动。
快速伸展臀部和膝盖，利用动量将壶铃摆动到肩膀高度。
当壶铃达到肩膀高度时，旋转手腕，将壶铃置于架子位置，肘部内收，壶铃靠在前臂上。
将壶铃放回双腿之间的起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。

0599.description: Seated on a machine, you curl your lower legs back and down against a pad. Isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将小腿放在带衬垫的杠杆下方，就在脚踝上方。
抓住机器两侧的手柄以提供支撑。
保持大腿不动，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并缓慢地将控制杆降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0663.description: A push-up with your hands on a medicine ball. The unstable base adds core and shoulder stability work.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手放在健身球上，距离与肩同宽。
弯曲肘部，保持背部挺直，调动核心力量，将身体降低至地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0727.description: Standing on one leg, you rise up onto your toes with the ball of your foot on a dumbbell. Works the calves with extra range.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃。
将一只脚抬离地面并用另一只脚保持平衡。
使用小腿肌肉，慢慢地将脚跟抬高，尽可能高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚跟。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一条腿。

0791.description: Raising a straight leg out to the side while standing. It strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Stand tall beside a wall or chair for balance.
Keep your hips square and toes pointing forward.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

0855.description: A standing torso rotation holding a weight. It builds the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a weight at your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly without jerking.

0919.description: A single-leg stiff-leg deadlift with a band. It builds the hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Stand on the band on one leg and hold the ends.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward with a flat back and kick the free leg back.
Return by driving your hips forward.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0983.description: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Kneel down and hold the band with one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully overhead, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Engage your lat muscles and pull the band down towards your side, bringing your elbow towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在头顶上方坚固的锚点上。
跪下，用一只手握住弹力带，手掌朝下。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
调动你的背阔肌，将弹力带拉向你的一侧，使你的肘部靠近你的胸腔。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。
